children: Stellantis shares edged higher after earnings as the company said it was exceeding cost-saving targets. Shares remain down over 56% year to date and 84% below their March 2024 peak.
Stellantis registrations in Italy fell 5.5% in October as the market grew 4.8%; share dropped to 24.2% from 26.8%. Year to date, registrations rose 12.1% and share reached 29.4%.
Stellantis (STLAM) said an electronic component shortage is disrupting production of some Fiat models in Italy. Disruptions may continue through November and December.
Stellantis may face congressional scrutiny if Democrats gain control, as they could challenge relaxed emissions rules. The automaker has scaled back EV plans and lobbied for looser standards.
Stellantis named Sandeep Bhambra design head for Citroën and DS Automobiles, effective Nov. 2, 2026. He succeeds Pierre Leclercq and Thierry Metroz, reporting to Gilles Vidal.
Stellantis (STLAM) expanded Direct Connection upgrades for select Ram 1500 TRX and Dodge Durango SRT Hellcat models. Kits add up to 40 hp and are available for $2,195.
